messages.subject: Re: What's for dynr?!?
messages.body_plain:
I added a welcome message for the group:

Forum to ask questions relating to the dynr <https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/dynr/index.html> packages in R, as well as discuss IRT analysis more generally. Bug reports or feature requests should be reported on the respective development versions of the packages on bitbucket (dynr-issues <https://bitbucket.org/mhunter/dynr/issues?status=new&status=open>).

Anyone can see this message when one access this group.

Dongjun
